messages:
maria-cs: Heads-up Crescent seeing intermittent 401s + short 429 bursts during SDK boot after they changed their edge/WAF. Ticket C-421.
liam-eng: Is it a single host or many clients? Can you paste a sanitized example request?
maria-cs: Single host. Payload:
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}
They see ~1/10 requests 401 and bursts of 429s.
zara-ps: Two suspects: proxy/WAF trimming Authorization or short TTL causing refresh stampede. What is TTL?
maria-cs: Tokens TTL = 15s, many pre-warmed serverless instances refreshing.
sam-sre: Short TTL + sync refresh = fanout. Also some proxies strip Authorization header. Ask them to add X-Debug-Id and capture headers.
liam-eng: Ask them to run: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Debug-Id:probe123" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"probe"}' and paste results.
maria-cs: Customer logs (tokens redacted): [09:20:13Z] 200 OK X-Debug-Id=probe123 req=abc123; [09:20:13Z] 401 Unauthorized X-Debug-Id=probe124 req=abc124 auth=missing; [09:20:14Z] 429 Too Many Requests X-Debug-Id=probe125 req=abc125 rate=client_concurrency; [09:20:15Z] 200 OK X-Debug-Id=probe126 req=abc126
sam-sre: That suggests header dropped mid-chain. Any CDN/WAF in front?
maria-cs: Yes they run a managed WAF and API gateway and they modified rules right before failures.
liam-eng: If nginx is used, ensure proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization; often missed. Ask them to bypass/disable suspect WAF rules and retry.
zara-ps: Short-term mitigation: increase TTL to ~60s and add jitter to token refresh to avoid synchronized bursts.
maria-cs: They disabled suspect WAF groups and retried: 10/10 200s; 429s largely resolved after tweaking refresh.
liam-eng: Next steps: fix WAF rule so Authorization forwards unchanged, raise TTL for onboarding, monitor 429 windows, optionally provide temporary elevated ingress for ramp.
zara-ps: I'll draft an onboarding checklist (nginx/envoy snippets, TTL guidance, refresh jitter) and share.
maria-cs: Updating ticket and asking for WAF post-mortem. Thanks all :thumbsup:
